app_name.description: Extension name shown by Chrome and in the extension UI.

app_short_name.description: Short extension name shown where Chrome has limited space.

app_description.message: Privacy-first local Google Meet controls for Stream Deck.
app_description.description: Short extension description shown by Chrome and the Chrome Web Store.

popup_tagline.message: Local. Open source. No meeting media or communications.
popup_tagline.description: Short privacy tagline in the popup.

popup_status_loading.description: Initial popup status while the background worker responds.

popup_pairing_code_label.description: Label for the eight-digit pairing code field.

popup_pairing_help.message: Pairing requests Chrome's optional host access only for the configured WebSocket origin on 127.0.0.1. No LAN or all-URL access is requested.
popup_pairing_help.description: Explanation immediately below the pairing code field.

popup_pair_button_default.description: Default label for the pairing submit button.

popup_pair_button_connecting.description: Pairing button label while a connection is being established.

popup_connect_button_default.description: Button that reconnects an already paired extension after permission recovery.

popup_connect_button_connecting.description: Stored-pair recovery button label while connecting.

popup_bridge_port_label.description: Label for the numeric loopback bridge port.

popup_save_button.description: Button that saves the bridge port.

popup_forget_button.description: Button that removes the local pairing credential.

popup_footer.message: Open source by annonator · Loopback only
popup_footer.description: Footer emphasizing the publisher and loopback-only transport.

error_background_unavailable.message: Meet Deck's background service is unavailable. Reload the extension.
error_background_unavailable.description: Shown when the popup cannot reach its service worker.

error_invalid_pairing_code.message: Enter the eight-digit code from the Stream Deck Property Inspector.
error_invalid_pairing_code.description: Shown when the pairing-code input is malformed.

error_invalid_bridge_port.message: Enter a local bridge port from 1024 through 65535.
error_invalid_bridge_port.description: Shown when the configured loopback port is invalid.

error_loopback_permission_denied.message: Chrome denied access to the configured loopback address. Choose Pair or Connect to request it again, or review Meet Deck's optional loopback host access in chrome://extensions.
error_loopback_permission_denied.description: Shown after the user denies the optional loopback host permission.

error_loopback_permission_request_failed.message: Chrome could not complete the loopback permission request. Keep the popup open and try again.
error_loopback_permission_request_failed.description: Shown when Chrome cannot complete the permission API request.

error_bridge_unavailable_pairing.message: The local Stream Deck bridge is unavailable. Is the Stream Deck app running with pairing open?
error_bridge_unavailable_pairing.description: Shown when the bridge cannot be reached during pairing.

error_bridge_message_failed.message: The local bridge could not be reached.
error_bridge_message_failed.description: Shown when an extension-to-worker bridge request fails.

error_port_save_failed.message: The port could not be saved.
error_port_save_failed.description: Shown when saving the configured bridge port fails.

error_forget_failed.message: The pairing could not be removed.
error_forget_failed.description: Shown when removing the pairing credential fails.

error_permission_cleanup_failed.message: Meet Deck changed the local connection, but Chrome could not remove the previous loopback permission. Review Meet Deck's optional loopback host access in chrome://extensions.
error_permission_cleanup_failed.description: Shown when unpairing succeeds but optional permission cleanup fails.

connection_connected.description: Connection status after mutual authentication succeeds.

connection_connecting.description: Connection status while connecting or pairing.

connection_bridge_unavailable.description: Connection status when a paired bridge cannot be reached.

meeting_one.message: One active meeting can be controlled.
meeting_one.description: Meeting status when exactly one joined meeting is available.

meeting_multiple.message: Multiple active meetings detected—control is safely blocked.
meeting_multiple.description: Meeting status when more than one joined meeting is detected.

meeting_none.description: Meeting status when no joined meeting can be controlled.

problem_authentication_failed.message: Mutual authentication failed. Pair both sides again.
problem_authentication_failed.description: Detailed bridge problem shown after authentication failure.

problem_bridge_unavailable.message: The local bridge is unavailable. Is the Stream Deck app running?
problem_bridge_unavailable.description: Detailed bridge problem shown when the local plugin is unavailable.

problem_invalid_pairing_code.description: Detailed bridge problem for an invalid code.

problem_loopback_permission_denied.message: Chrome denied Meet Deck access to the configured loopback address. Choose Pair or Connect to request it again.
problem_loopback_permission_denied.description: Detailed bridge problem after loopback host permission denial.

problem_loopback_permission_required.message: Chrome needs your approval before Meet Deck can reach the configured loopback address. Choose Pair or Connect to continue.
problem_loopback_permission_required.description: Detailed bridge problem when the optional loopback host permission is missing.

problem_pairing_expired.message: The pairing code has expired. Generate a new one in the Property Inspector.
problem_pairing_expired.description: Detailed bridge problem for an expired pairing code.

problem_protocol_error.message: The bridge sent unexpected data. The connection was closed as a precaution.
problem_protocol_error.description: Detailed bridge problem after protocol validation fails.

error_secure_storage_unavailable.message: Chrome could not restrict the Meet Deck pairing credential to trusted extension contexts.
error_secure_storage_unavailable.description: Shown when trusted-context-only extension storage cannot be enabled.

error_not_paired.message: Meet Deck is not paired yet. Open pairing in Stream Deck and enter the displayed code.
error_not_paired.description: Shown when reconnect is requested without a stored pairing credential.

onboarding_eyebrow.description: Product and publisher label above the onboarding heading.

onboarding_heading.message: Meet Deck does not access meeting media.

onboarding_lead.message: Meet Deck connects Google Meet and Stream Deck only over IPv4 loopback. No cloud, no telemetry, and no meeting media or communications.

onboarding_step_plugin_body.message: Install the open-source plugin and drag a Meet Deck action onto an LCD key.

onboarding_step_pair_body.message: Generate an eight-digit code in the Property Inspector. It expires quickly and works only on this computer.

onboarding_step_connect_body.message: Open the Meet Deck popup, enter the code, and choose Pair and connect. Chrome may ask you to allow Meet Deck to reach only the configured WebSocket origin on 127.0.0.1.
onboarding_step_connect_body.description: Third onboarding step instructions describing the host-permission flow.

onboarding_privacy_heading.description: Heading above the onboarding data summary.

onboarding_privacy_yes.description: Label for data that Meet Deck processes.

onboarding_privacy_yes_body.message: Visible control labels are inspected transiently. The local plugin receives only whether zero, one, or multiple meetings are active plus finite microphone, camera, hand, and own-presentation states.
onboarding_privacy_yes_body.description: Summary of the minimum derived state Meet Deck processes.

onboarding_privacy_no.description: Label for data that Meet Deck does not process.

onboarding_privacy_no_body.message: No meeting URLs, codes, titles, names, chats, captions, audio, video, or screen data.
onboarding_privacy_no_body.description: Summary of meeting information Meet Deck does not process.

onboarding_open_popup_button.message: Open Meet Deck in the toolbar
onboarding_open_popup_button.description: Button that attempts to open the extension popup.

onboarding_open_popup_fallback.message: Pin Meet Deck from Chrome's Extensions menu, then select its icon in the toolbar.
onboarding_open_popup_fallback.description: Fallback shown when Chrome cannot open the popup programmatically.
